title: play_interrupt_event
description: A player plays an interrupt event before its triggering condition resolves, whether or not they have the opportunity to act (e.g. Stay Your Hand during a duel initiated by an opponent), and pays its cost (`card_cost`); the event goes to the discard pile of its owner. From their hand, or from elsewhere when a card allows it: an event of a hand, a conflict deck (a card looked at) or a conflict discard pile, of any player. The player resolves its effects with other actions, then ends it (`end_resolution`): the opportunities to act do not change. Action and reaction events are played with `play_action_event` and `play_reaction_event`.

card_id.description: Interrupt event played: in a hand, a conflict deck or a conflict discard pile.
